comparison.objective: Hold a hand grinder steady and turn its crank clockwise three complete revolutions.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus continuous constrained rotary manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Three full clockwise turns with the grinder held steady; stability tolerance is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Tests repeated rotary articulation under stabilization. The candidate instead requires coaxial mandrel holding during a transient hammer strike, physical fracture, withdrawal, and fragment recovery. No spec versions were provided.
